item.title: Warren County Records: Marriage licenses, warranty deeds, and deeds of trust from Feb. 18 to 24, 2026
item.description: Warren County recorded marriage licenses, warranty deeds, and deeds of trust from Feb. 18 to 24, 2026, detailing recent unions and property transactions across the area.

item.title: James Odester Green
item.description: A graveside service honoring the life of James Odester Green will be held Feb. 28, at 2 p.m.

item.title: Old Post Files: A look back over the last 100 years on Feb. 27, 2026
item.description: Old Post Files is a regular feature within the pages of The Vicksburg Post's print edition and digital e-edition. This feature looks back at some of the happenings from the pages of The Vicksburg Post over the past 100 years. Enjoy.

item.title: Godshaw continues family tradition by signing with Meridian soccer
item.description: Warren Central's Emily Godshaw became the third member of her family to receive a college soccer scholarship when she signed with Meridian Community College.

item.title: Alcorn tennis teams come to Halls Ferry for home matches
item.description: Alcorn State's women’s tennis team started a weekend homestand at Vicksburg's Halls Ferry Park by playing Kennesaw State on Friday, and the men's team will play Texas-Rio Grande Valley Saturday at 10 a.m.

item.title: Mayor: Audit shows prior admin left city with $7.29M deficit, lacked internal controls
item.description: Vicksburg mayor says prior administration spent $7.29M more than it took in, left utilities running losses and ignored long‑standing internal control warnings.

item.title: Refuge church to celebrate 25 years of worship
item.description: Refuge Church in Vicksburg will mark 25 years of ministry for Pastors Tony and Bethany Winkler with a community worship celebration Sunday, March 1, at 10:30 a.m.

item.title: Army officials tout ‘Building Infrastructure, Not Paperwork’ initiative in Vicksburg
item.description: Federal leaders say effort aims to cut red tape, speed Corps of Engineers projects nationwide

item.title: Baseball Roundup: Justin and Justin adjust Vikings' win total
item.description: Justin Evans had four hits and scored three runs, and Justin Greer allowed one run in 4 1/3 innings pitched to lead Warren Central's baseball team past Parklane Academy on Friday.

item.title: Lady Flashes pull away from PCA with second-half surge
item.description: St. Aloysius scored twice late in the first half, then added five goals in 22 minutes in the second to beat Porter's Chapel Academy 8-0 in an MAIS girls soccer game on Friday.
